page.title: Marketplace
page.description: Plugins, skills and MCP servers for your agents, from the makers of the tools you use and from the community.

add.heading: Add your own
add.mcpLine: A command to run, or a URL
add.marketplaceLine: A GitHub repository or Git URL
add.skillGithubLine: A repository, or a folder in one

catalog.emptyText: The MCP Registry lists no servers your agents can run right now.
catalog.stale: The MCP Registry couldn’t be reached, so the catalog may be out of date.
catalog.staleSince: The MCP Registry couldn’t be reached, so this is the catalog from {{ago}}.

install.title: Install {{name}}
install.note: Kettu keeps it and hands it to these agents when a session starts.
install.secretHint: Kept on this computer and never shown again.

toast.keysNotSaved: {{name}} is installed, but its keys weren’t saved: {{error}}
toast.connected: Connected to {{name}}; every chosen agent can use it

listing.missingText: It may have left the MCP Registry, or been uninstalled.
listing.signsIn: Signs in with {{service}} in your browser

installed.emptyText: Install servers from All, or add your own with Add.
installed.noPlugins: No agent has a plugin yet. Install one from Plugins.
installed.marketplacesNote: Where each agent finds plugins. Its harness’s own marketplace stays.
installed.noSkills: Kettu keeps no skills yet. Install one from Skills.
installed.ownSkillsNote: The skills each agent keeps itself. Kettu shows them; change them in the agent.

kettu.note: Artifacts, sessions and the browser reach every agent through Kettu’s own server.
kettu.notRunningBody: Sessions start without its tools until it runs.

agent.on: Adds these tools to its sessions.
agent.off: Its sessions start without these tools.
agent.takesNone: {{name}} takes no MCP servers over HTTP.

own.title: In each agent’s own configuration
own.note: Each agent also connects to the servers it keeps itself. Kettu shows where; change them in the agent.
own.withCommand: Its own servers too. Type {{command}} in a session to see them, or add {{file}} to a project.
own.withCommandFrom: Its own servers too, from {{path}}. Type {{command}} in a session to see them, or add {{file}} to a project.
own.withCommandMissing: Its own servers too. Type {{command}} in a session to see them, or add {{file}} to a project. {{path}} is not created yet.
own.from: Its own servers too, from {{path}} and {{file}} in a project.
own.fromMissing: Its own servers too, from {{file}} in a project. {{path}} is not created yet.

keys.title: Keys for {{name}}
keys.description: Type a value to replace the one kept on this computer. Kettu never shows a secret again.

agents.title: Agents for {{name}}
agents.description: Their new sessions get the server; sessions already open keep what they started with.

uninstall.title: Uninstall {{name}}?
uninstall.body: New sessions start without it, and its keys are deleted from this computer.

add.title: Add an MCP server
add.description: Every agent gets it when a session starts. Values marked secret are kept on this computer and never shown again.
add.name: Name
add.nameHint: What agents call it: lowercase letters, digits, - and _.
add.nameFormat: Use lowercase letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter or digit.
add.nameReserved: kettu is the name of Kettu’s own server.
add.nameTaken: Another server already has this name.
add.urlInvalid: Enter an http or https address.
add.commandHint: The program and its arguments; quote an argument with spaces.
add.commandEmpty: Enter the command that starts the server.
add.secretHint: Agents receive every value; a secret is kept apart from the settings.
add.valueNameInvalid: This name can’t be used here.
add.valueNameTaken: This name is already used above.

uninstallPlugin.title: Uninstall {{name}}?
uninstallPlugin.body: {{agent}} removes it from its configuration; its sessions start without it.

removeSkill.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeSkill.body: Agents’ new sessions start without it, and its files are deleted from this computer.

removeMarketplace.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeMarketplace.body: {{agent}} stops listing its plugins; plugins already installed from it may stop working.

marketplace.title: Add a plugin marketplace
marketplace.description: A marketplace lists plugins for Claude Code or Codex. The agent you pick keeps it in its own configuration.
marketplace.noAgents: Add a Claude Code or Codex agent first.
marketplace.sourceHint: A GitHub repository as owner/repo, or a Git URL.

skill.title: Add a skill from GitHub
skill.description: Kettu copies the skill to this computer and hands it to the agents you choose.
skill.urlHint: A repository, or a folder in it with a SKILL.md.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: New sessions start without it, and Kettu signs out of it on this computer.

notes.skills: Couldn’t read the skills catalog, so it may be out of date: {{error}}

empty.plugins: Claude Code and Codex list no plugins yet. Add a marketplace with Add.
empty.skills: The skills catalog is empty. Add a skill from GitHub or a folder with Add.

plugin.installNote: {{harness}} installs it into the agent’s own configuration, so its terminal sees it too.
plugin.hooksWarning: Has hooks: they run commands on this computer by themselves, outside the agent’s sandbox.

skill.installNote: Kettu keeps it on this computer and hands it to these agents when a session starts.
skill.howItWorks: An agent reads a skill when a task calls for it, so it costs little until then.

connect.title: Connect {{name}}
connect.browserNote: You sign in with {{service}} in your browser. Kettu keeps the sign-in, and these agents reach the server through Kettu.
connect.deviceNote: You enter a code at {{service}}. Kettu keeps the sign-in, and these agents reach the server through Kettu.
connect.browserWaiting: Finish signing in in your browser
connect.browserHint: Didn’t the page open? Copy the link into your browser.
connect.timedOut: Signing in took longer than five minutes, so Kettu stopped waiting.
